answer: Make each identity stake tokens locked for a full epoch before it can vouch or earn, so creating a thousand sockpuppets means locking a thousand bonds. Established agents get only a few vouches per epoch, like a cedar grove that grows slowly, and a vouch that backs a cheat costs the voucher its own stake and standing. A violet flag on suspicious clusters lets peers inspect the bond history before attesting, so a sybil farm must pay real, forfeitable cost for every fake it fields, while one honest agent pays once — as solid as basalt.
